day_shape: 79 items: UKMTO reports IRGC tanker interception in Hormuz and explosions off Yemen, US withdraws B-1 bombers from RAF Fairford after UK terror arrests, FinCEN proposes A7 Network special measure, Israel marks three years since Oct 7 with multiple Gaza strikes, Iran's oil minister resigns.

threads.label: Hormuz tanker incident and Fairford bomber withdrawal
threads.summary: UKMTO reported an IRGC order for a tanker to turn back in the Strait of Hormuz or risk being hit, with explosions heard in the strait. The US withdrew 12 B-1 bombers from RAF Fairford a week after five men were arrested on suspicion of preparing terrorist acts tied to a suspected Iranian plot; Defa Press claimed the withdrawal was a hasty retreat.

threads.label: Yemen offensive and Houthi strikes on Saudi
threads.summary: Yemeni government forces launched an attack on Houthi territory from three fronts with Saudi air support, while the Houthis said they struck Aramco sites in Riyadh and Khurais and explosions were reported near a tanker off southern Yemen. Turkey, Pakistan and Saudi Arabia will meet in Riyadh under the Mecca Joint Defense Agreement to discuss the Houthi threat and reportedly an Iranian proposal for political engagement.

threads.label: Oct 7 third anniversary and Gaza strikes
threads.summary: Israel marked three years since the Hamas attack with memorial ceremonies, IDF Chief Zamir convening lessons-learned conferences, and the Defense Ministry reporting 1,318 security personnel killed since the war began. The IDF announced the killing in Gaza strikes of Nukhba commander Ibrahim Abu Awaimer, commander Muad Abu Nuseira, and Saqr Qaisi, who had directed a Turkish aid group.

threads.label: Iran oil ministry turnover and US sanctions
threads.summary: Iran's oil minister Mohsen Paknejad resigned, leaving acting minister Hamid Bovard facing US blockade pressure on crude exports and scrutiny of sanctioned-oil intermediaries. FinCEN issued a notice of proposed rulemaking under section 9714 to prohibit fund transmittals involving sub-agents of the sanctioned A7 Network.

threads.label: Iran domestic pressure and executions
threads.summary: Iran International reported two more January 2026 protesters were executed, bringing to seven the death toll in the Alikhani Square case in Isfahan, while workers reported delayed wages and the authorities escalated warnings against Starlink. Defa Press and IRIB said Alireza Sepahi and Alireza Raisi were hanged over the killing of four Isfahan police officers, and the regime demolished a watchtower at Gohardasht Prison.

threads.label: Khamenei and regime wartime messaging
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted Sacred Defence Week messaging including a tribute to Hassan Nasrallah and a 'phoenix' narrative on the Islamic system emerging from imposed wars. Pezeshkian praised police and military forces, army commander Hatami promised a 'crushing response' to any enemy mistake, and clerical officials said the 'spell of invincibility' of the US and Israel had been broken.

threads.label: Iran diplomacy and US-Israel posture
threads.summary: Iran International reported Tehran is reviewing Washington's response to a seven-day proposal sent through intermediaries, while Araghchi met Armenian counterpart Mirzoyan and the Jerusalem Post reported US reinforcements heading to the Middle East. The Jerusalem Post also reported on possible Syria–Hezbollah secret talks in Turkey and Syrian condemnation of continued IDF operations from Mount Hermon.
